executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Hilton New York Times Square's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Meetings & Groups.

What the Data Is Telling Us. AI Consideration is 23.1%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, New York Marriott Marquis repeatedly appears instead — a concentrated substitution pattern rather than a diffuse competitor list. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The primary constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses. Softest Scenario Capture is Group / Meeting at 15.4%. New York Marriott Marquis most often appears when the hotel is missing (29 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Group / Meeting is the softest Scenario Capture at 15.4%. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. New York Marriott Marquis appears most often when the hotel is missing (29 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 50.0% (4 of 8 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Pet-Friendly.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Meetings & Groups. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Compare evidence from scenarios where New York Marriott Marquis appears with the property information currently available for Hilton New York Times Square. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.
